_title: Lab 1: Car rental billing (Python control flow and functions)

T2.text: The SUV and the Sedan are each rented for 12 days, which is more than the 10 day threshold, so a 10% discount is applied to their gross amount. The Hatchback is rented for only 4 days, so no discount applies. The refundable deposit of 500 is deducted from each payable amount. Writing the bill as a function lets the same rule be reused for every car.
